column1: # Runs set aside from the classic round (distill/PLAN_classic.md, amendment of 17 Nov 2026). Kept on the Modal volumes and
# fetched for the record, never used for training or counted towards the 40 runs per task.
# Rule: a task's runs from a stage are set aside when the server was overloaded and any of that task's runs in that stage was
# cut by the wall-clock limit, by request timeouts, or by us stopping its app. Such cuts remove the longest runs first, so the
# runs that did finish are a biased sample. The task is re-run from scratch at a load the server can hold.
